_comment: Owner annotations for SUPPORT_MODELING_SPEC.md, keyed by support name. Edited by the owner; read by support_spec_gen.py so regeneration never loses notes. Recovered from context 2026-06-10.
Additional Ignite: We also need to deal with the other stats it provides. The +1 stack of ignite and ignite chance. These don't need to function for the damage calculations but they do need to be dealt with in some way
Ailment Termination: Explained above. We also needs to factor in the - ailment duration part for the future because it will be relevant to damage/qol eventually
Attack Focus: This has the additional damage part but it also has the inc crit rating part per fervor rating. Both need to be modeled
Aura Amplification: Lets make a stat for this regarding aura effect. It should feed into the specific skill engine wise when I add it
Blind: This should also have % chance to blind also. These stats are important for a legendary later because they are control effects so we care about this.
Carpet Bombardment: We need to correctly model all of its stats. The increase damage per wave, the additional damage for the supported skill and the -wave interval part. (-wave interval needs to be a stat)
Channel Preparation: We need to increase the min channeled stack stat for the skill for this.
Control Spell: We need to model the -100% inc crit part as well as the additional damage. Also this only affects spell as made clear through its tags
Deep Wounds: We also need the % chance to inflict trauma to be dealt with somehow (probably as a stat)
Defense Layers: This also provides the energy shield cannot be interrupted by dmg for 1s line which we should track at some level.
Electric Overload: We need to also create its Electric Overload buff (as a condition) with the buff it grants (15% additional lightning damage to this skill) being supported too
Electric Punishment: This needs to have the conditional on if the enemy is numbed + the scaling per numbed stack the enemy has.
Elemental Duo: This is dropping the +1 max summonable minions part which isn't right.
Elemental Fusion: This is silently dropping the cannot inflict ignite, frostbite, numbed part which is wrong.
Fire Explosion: We need to note the affliction per second mod that is conditional on dealing damage recently
Glacial Freeze: We are silently dropping the inflict frostbite line which we need to deal with.
Grudge: This is conditional additional damage as you identified. The 2nd part needs to be something we track as well because it is a way to auto derive application of paralysis (aka if this exists we can assume paralysis active and it should be filtered into the skills damage contribution if its the only source of paralysis)
Haunt: We are silently dropping the +2 shadow quantity which is the supports entire value. Even though this damage type isnt modeled yet it should be counted somehow.
High Voltage: We cant silently dropp the numbed application line
Hunting Tempo: We can skip this one for now, its very complex and not used often
Improved Corrosion: We should model this like the ignite mod where the 1 additional stacks of wilt inflicted and the chance to wilt are kept as stats
Increased Area: We also need to track its +skill area contribution
Jump: The +2 jumps need to be evaluated here because its the entire value of the support (much like haunt)
Lightning to Cold: This is damage conversion, we should revist all damage conversion later when we do that part of the roadmap
Manifold Entanglement: This needs special attention when we implement tangles. Revisit it then
Multiple Projectiles: This is silently dropping the +2 proj quant (similar to haunt/jumps) This cannot be silently dropped
Multistrike: We are silently dropping the increasing damage line as well. Both needs to be parsed
Nova Shot: The proj speed needs to be additional (probably new stat) not increased pool.
Overload: This is correct, it is 1 bucket so 3.05*focus_blessing_count would be the value.
Passivation: This does need an enemy life model. We are also silently dropping the downside of cannot inflict wilt which cannot happen.
Physical to Fire: Defer all conversion supports to roadmap #5
Precision Strike: We can model part of this skill, we should create the ailment dmg additional stat and then we are also dropping the -30% skill area downside silently.
Projectile Penetration: We should keep track of this in its correct stat, it will matter for damage calculation later.
Projectile Split: We are silently dropping the 50% chance to +2 split line which cannot happen.
Quick Return: We need to create the stat demolisher_charge_resto_speed_inc
Recklessness: We will come to this part again when we deal with life consume stuff
Recuperation: Revist when we do combo skills
Refracted Prism: We are silently dropping the +2 refractions line and the -10% additional beam length. These both need to be dealt with
Scattershot Beam: We are silently dropping the +2 beams, that cant be dropped silently.
Slow Projectile: We need to model the -additional proj speed modifier
Spell Concentration: We are silently dropped the -skill area downside
Spell Tangle: Defer till tangles part in roadmap
Steamroll: This should actually be dealt with by adding that stat as mentioned above. We also silently dropped the -attack speed modifier which isn't okay.
Tendonslicer: This needs to be dealt with differently. We need to factor in its debuff that it creates and model its damage contribution as well. Proper contributions to this would require hit rate information but we can ignore that for now and assume 100% debuff uptime essentially.
Wind Projectiles: This needs to contribute the projectile speed as well and the additional damage. It silently drops inc projectile speed
Willpower: This is dropping all of its lines silently. We need to work on this as a condition for Willpower Stacks, each of which gives 6% additional damage (multiplies) up to 6 while you are standing still. So we need to check the numeric condition for willpower buffs + the standing still condition
